title: [YouPass Collect] - Olive Oil Production Process
prompt: The diagram details the process of producing olive oil. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the procedure for producing olive oil from harvested olives.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the process comprises several main stages: initial fruit collection and cleaning, mechanical oil extraction and final separation and storage of the products.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the initial stages, olives are picked from the trees and deposited into collection vats where they are subjected to leaf removal and washing. Next, the cleaned fruit is transferred to an olive mill and crushed to form an olive paste. This paste then undergoes malaxation at temperatures below 27°C, a gentle mixing step that helps small oil droplets coalesce. After malaxation, the paste is directed into a centrifugal separator (centrifuge), where the bulk of the oil is mechanically extracted and separated from the solid material.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: From this stage onwards, the extracted liquid stream is subsequently treated to yield consumable oil and waste streams. Virgin oil is first transferred to a decanter for clarification, allowing solids and water to settle out. Any remaining liquid is passed through a separation stage in which residual wastewater is removed and either treated or discharged as effluent, while the purified oil is collected. The solid residue, or pomace, is removed from the centrifuge and transported for further refining or processing at specialist facilities. Finally, the clarified oil is deposited into a storage tank, ready for bottling or distribution.
